spans.s: 1. आश्चर्य mfn. (said to be fr. √ चर् with आ and a sibilant inserted, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 147), appearing rarely, curious, marvellous, astonishing, wonderful, extraordinary, KaṭhUp.; Prab.; Śak.; Ragh.
wonder, surprise, astonishment, R.; Bhag.; Śak. &c.
2. आश्चर्य Nom. P. आश्चर्यति, to be marvellous or strange, L.
आश्चर्य—ता, f. or आश्चर्य—त्व, n. wonderfulness, wonder, astonishment.
आश्चर्य—ता, f. or आश्चर्य—त्व, n. wonderfulness, wonder, astonishment.
आश्चर्य—भूत mfn. having a marvellous appearance, wonderful, R.
आश्चर्य—मञ्जरी f. N. of a Kāvya.
आश्चर्य—मय mfn. wonderful, marvellous, miraculous, Kathās.; Bhag.
आश्चर्य—रामायण n. N. of a Kāvya.
आश्चर्य—रूप mfn. being of marvellous appearance, strange, wonderful, NṛsUp.
